name: UGCify – UGC for WooCommerce ( Customer Photos, Videos & Visual Reviews )
author: RexTheme

sections.description:
** Turn your WooCommerce product reviews into a conversion engine!**
Powered by real buyer photos, videos, and social proof.

Automatically collect UGC (customer photos and video reviews) after every purchase and display them as shoppable UGC galleries on your product pages.

Plus, you can import and display social posts about your products (based on hashtags) (Pro) as part of your product reviews!

Why? Because this, in turn, will help build trust in your store and lead to more conversions!

93% of consumers say user-generated content influences their buying decisions more than brand content.

With UGCify, you can:

✅ Collect customer photo & video reviews automatically
✅ Add shoppable UGC galleries on WooCommerce product pages
✅ Combine visual reviews with WooCommerce star ratings
✅ Moderate and approve all submissions before they go live
✅ Tag products in customer images with purchase path (Pro)

Unlike generic review plugins, UGCify is built specifically for WooCommerce stores that want to turn product UGC & social proof into a marketing engine; self-hosted, with full data ownership and no recurring fees.

Key Solutions You Get With UGCify To Grow WooCommerce Conversions

Visual Review System
Let customers drop reviews with real photos and videos of the products they purchased.

Automated UGC Collection
Trigger post-purchase emails automatically and collect customer photos and video reviews with smart timing.

Shoppable UGC Galleries
Display real buyer content in responsive grid, masonry, or carousel layouts with product tagging and direct purchase paths.

WooCommerce Reviews Integration
Merge visual UGC with star ratings and written reviews for stronger social proof on every product page.

Self-Hosted Social Proof Marketing
Everything lives on your server. No third-party dependency, no monthly fees.

You can learn more details about these in the next section.

Check out UGCify LTD starting at $49! 🔥
👉 View LTD Offer

Documentation | Need Help? Contact Us

Polished Studio Photos Aren’t Enough To Convert Buyers…

One of the main reasons people hesitate to place orders online is ‘lack of trust.’

Now, you always add high-quality, polished photos when adding products to your WooCommerce shop.

But did you know?
While your studio photos grab attention, people don’t really trust them…

Buyers are concerned about whether they will get exactly what was shown in the product images.

Think about the last time you placed an order.

You obviously looked for some reviews first. But that’s not all.
You also tend to look for reviews that include a photo or video showcasing what the buyer received.

Your customers do the same!

Why? Because it removes most of the doubt around authenticity and quality!

Modern shoppers scroll past your polished product photos and look for something real: actual customers, genuinely using your products, in their real lives.

If your WooCommerce product pages don’t show customer photos and videos, you’re leaving conversions on the table every single day.

UGCify is built to exactly help you fix this… Automatically.

How UGCify Can Help Your WooCommerce Store

UGCify was built with one goal: to help WooCommerce stores actively leverage UGC to build trust and increase conversions, without high costs.

Build instant trust with new shoppers
In 2026, user-generated content and influencer reviews are the strongest trust signals for online shoppers. And as a WooCommerce store owner, you can use UGCify to collect and display real customer photos and videos, influencer product reviews, and social posts from actual buyers right on the product page, removing doubts about the product and driving more orders.

Increase conversions with help from buyers
Get more buyers to believe in your products by replacing studio-only images with real buyer photos and videos, leading to higher conversion rates and fewer drop-offs from the product page.

Automate authentic visual review collection
Instead of chasing customers manually, you can put the entire process on autopilot. Customers submit photos and videos alongside their reviews, and the content flows straight into a moderation queue ready to publish.

Native & Self-hosting without the high costs
There are very few UGC tools dedicated to WooCommerce. And most SaaS UGC tools cost between $110 and $5,000 a year. UGCify gives your WooCommerce store the same leverage as SaaS UGC tools without the high bills and with full ownership of data!

Getting Started Is Simple

  1. Activate UGCify and import existing WooCommerce reviews.
  2. (Optional) Update review request emails if needed.
  3. (Pro) Choose from more effective review layouts.
  4. (Pro) Customize the colors to match your brand.
  5. (Pro) Import social proof via hashtags in the reviews
  6. Start receiving UGC and grow.

**With the UGCify premium plugin, you get multiple review layouts, you can import social proof based on hashtags, manage influencer content, set up points & rewards systems for customers, set up automation workflows, and more.

Once you have UGC in place, you will now start seeing people spending more time on product pages. And you will observe higher conversion rates.

We have top-quality support! If you have questions, don’t hesitate to reach out to us.

Who Is UGCify For?

  • Fashion and apparel stores that need real buyers wearing their products
  • Beauty and skincare shops that rely on before-and-after video reviews
  • Home and living brands where lifestyle photos outsell product shots
  • Electronics and gadget stores that want authentic video reviews from real buyers
  • Any WooCommerce store ready to turn product reviews into a social proof marketing engine

Everything You Need To Turn Product Reviews Into Shoppable UGC

Every feature in UGCify is built to help you build a conversion engine around customer reviews, UGC, and social proof marketing.

👉 Automated UGC Collection

The hardest part of building social proof is getting customers to submit content.

UGCify automatically reaches out to buyers via email after an order is completed to request that they drop a review. Buyers will be able to visit the product and easily upload photos and videos directly from their device.

And you can also use automation workflows (Pro) to set up further follow-up requests in case they do not leave a review initially.

So, no chasing customers or manual follow-ups.

👉 Photo & Video Reviews for WooCommerce

When we say visuals, we mean both photos and videos. Customers can easily upload quick photos from their photo galleries or short video reviews.

Video reviews give new shoppers the real-life product context that studio photos and text reviews simply cannot deliver, especially for fashion, beauty, and electronics stores.

The overall visual experience will give new shoppers the real-life context they need to feel confident in placing orders.

  • Supported Image Formats: JPG, PNG, GIF
  • Supported Video Formats: MP4, MOV, WebM
  • Upload file size limit control.

So, you can turn your product review section from a list of texts into a living gallery of real buyer experiences.

👉 Shoppable UGC Galleries

Display real buyer content in responsive layouts on any product page, replacing the default star and text reviews.

And when viewing these photos and videos, shoppers will get an option to directly add the product to the cart without having to go back and find the product.

  • Minimal Block Gallery layout (grid, masonry, carousel, and slider)
  • Reels Style layout (with stories and column control) (Pro)
  • Amazon-style Carousel layout (Pro)
  • Individual review modal
  • Embed via Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, or shortcode for Divi and others
  • Product tagging (Pro) — adds interactive hotspots to customer images linking directly to product pages and Add to Cart buttons
  • Fully responsive to any device

The UGC gallery is not only visually appealing but also acts as a direct purchase path for new buyers.

👉 Easy Review Moderation Dashboard

Every submission goes through your dashboard before it goes live. Approve, reject, or organize content from one clean interface easily.

Plus, you can also edit and modify any reviews when needed.

  • Review, approve, reject, or organize all incoming review submissions from one interface
  • Edit and update reviews if needed.

👉 Social Media Import (Pro)

Nowadays, most customers post about anything they purchase on Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube.

With UGCify, you can pull content from there directly based on hashtags used by the customer or URLs.

  • Import public posts from Instagram & TikTok hashtags.
  • Pull in YouTube URLs as video UGC.
  • Map reviews to their respective products.

This means you can encourage your customers to include your brand name as hashtags when posting on social media. Then you not only get some public authority, but you also get to use them as UGC on your product page.

👉 Rewards & Gamification (Pro)

Encourage customers to keep contributing content by rewarding them for it. UGCify’s rewards system gives you a structured way to recognize and incentivize your most active contributors.

  • Set up point distribution based on content type or submission volume
  • Define a badge system based on points earned.
  • Assign discount rewards per x points within different badges.

You always keep your buyers motivated to share their experience while you leverage this to create repeat purchases.

👉 Influencer UGC Portal (Pro)

For stores working with brand ambassadors or content creators, UGCify provides a dedicated portal that makes bulk content contribution and rights management simple.

  • Invite-only interface for brand ambassadors and influencers
  • Bulk upload of high-quality content directly to your moderation queue
  • Manage contribution rights from one place
  • Keep influencer content separate from general customer submissions

👉 UGC A/B Testing (Pro)

Understand exactly how your UGC galleries are performing and which content drives the most conversions. UGCify’s A/B testing suite gives you the data you need to optimize your social proof strategy over time.

  • Compare how different UGC galleries perform against standard product photos
  • Track click-throughs and conversions directly attributed to UGC content
  • Test different gallery layouts and content combinations
  • Use real data to decide which customer content to prioritize

👉 Performance & Compatibility

UGCify is built to run fast and work with the tools you already use; no conflicts, no slowdowns, no complicated setup.

  • Lazy loading, image compression, and optimized database queries
  • Typical page speed impact under 50ms
  • Works with Astra, Storefront, OceanWP, Kadence, GeneratePress, Flatsome, and all WooCommerce-compatible themes
  • Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, and shortcode support for Divi and others
  • All customer content is stored on your own server — no external SaaS dependency, no data privacy concerns, or monthly fees
  • Option to connect AWS/S3 to store uploaded media to reduce server load.

👉 WooCommerce Product Reviews Integration

You can easily import all your current WooCommerce reviews into UGCify with a single click. These will appear among your newly collected photo or video reviews in a more visually appealing way.

Plus, if you can ask past customers to share photos with you personally, you can then upload them by editing the old text ratings, turning them into visual UGC.

All UGCify Free & Pro Features

FREE FEATURES

  • Automated review collection via email
  • Easy review moderation
  • Collect photo and video reviews
  • Minimal Block Gallery layout (grid, masonry, carousel, and slider)
  • Customize review form color & texts
  • Customize default review emails
  • WooCommerce reviews migration
  • Shoppable UGC – Add to cart from reviews
  • ReCaptcha support

PRO FEATURES

  • Reels Style layout (with stories and column control)
  • Amazon-style Carousel layout
  • Customize layout colors and content
  • Email automation workflows (via Mail Mint)
  • Influencer Content Portal
  • Instagram UGC import via hashtags
  • TikTok UGC import via hashtags
  • YouTube UGC import via URL
  • Points, Badges, and Discount Rewards System
  • A/B Testing UGC
  • AWS/S3 storage integration for UGC content

💡 Can’t find what you are looking for? Submit your ideas or suggestions HERE.

Why Choose UGCify Over Other WooCommerce Review & UGC Review Plugins?

UGCify is intentionally built for WooCommerce, which means every feature is built to complement your existing store.

There’s no awkward workaround or third-party bridge needed.

It’s a strong, cost-effective alternative to plugins like Cusrev, Review X, or WiserReview, with a focus on the tools you actually need to collect & leverage visual user-generated content to build trust and increase conversions.

We promise you the following:

  • UGCify will be easier to use compared to other tools.
  • You will see visible results – more time on page and more conversions – within a month.
  • You won’t have to pay extra as you scale.
  • We have top-notch support to help you at all times.

Get Started with UGCify

If you’re a WooCommerce store owner looking to avoid losing buyers due to a lack of trust, build authority through social proof, and stop paying tons of dollars to expensive SaaS UGC tools, start using UGCify today!

Join our bustling community and connect with thousands of WooCommerce store owners. Take part in discussions, see how others are growing their online business, and stay updated on exciting new releases!

🤝 Join Now

Privacy Policy

If you explicitly opt in to usage tracking, we collect specific telemetry data via PostHog to improve plugin performance and troubleshoot issues.

What Data is Collected?

No data is collected by default. If you provide consent, the following information is gathered:
* System Environment: WordPress version, PHP version, and active theme/plugin names.
* Plugin Details: UGCify version and non-sensitive configuration settings.
* Usage Patterns: Feature usage and in-plugin page views.
* Contact Info: Site administrator email address.

External services

This plugin connects to the following external services. No data is sent to any of these services unless you explicitly use the corresponding feature.

Meta / Instagram Graph API

Used by the Instagram integration feature to authenticate your Instagram Business account via OAuth and to fetch public posts matching your configured hashtags.

  • What is sent: During OAuth, your browser is redirected to Meta’s login page. After authorisation, the plugin exchanges an authorisation code for an access token using your site’s server. Hashtag search requests include your access token and the hashtag text.
  • When it is sent: Only when an admin connects an Instagram account or when the scheduled hashtag sync runs (requires the integration to be enabled and configured).
  • Service provider: Meta Platforms, Inc.
  • Terms of service: https://developers.facebook.com/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

YouTube oEmbed API

Used to fetch metadata (title, thumbnail) for YouTube video URLs that are imported as video reviews.

  • What is sent: The YouTube video URL.
  • When it is sent: Only when an admin imports a YouTube video review.
  • Service provider: Google LLC
  • Terms of service: https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/api-services-tos
  • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

TikTok Embed

sections.faq:
1. Does this work with my theme?

If your theme supports WooCommerce, it supports UGCify. We use native WooCommerce hooks for maximum compatibility.

We’ve tested with all major themes including Astra, Storefront, OceanWP, Kadence, and GeneratePress.

2. Will it replace or remove my existing WooCommerce product reviews?

No. UGCify will not remove any existing reviews.

UGCify extends your existing WooCommerce reviews. Customer photos and videos appear alongside star ratings and written reviews — making your review section richer and more convincing without replacing anything.

2. Will this slow down my site?

No. UGCify uses lazy loading, image compression, and optimized database queries. Typical page speed impact is under 50ms.

3, Can customers upload video reviews?

Yes. Customers can upload both photos and videos as part of their product review.

Supported formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, MP4, WebM.

4. Do I need to manually send emails to collect UGC?

No. Post-purchase collection emails are fully automated. Whenever an order is complited, the email will be sent out.

You can even set up automation workflows to send further follow-up emails. Though this is part of the Pro plugin.

5. How is this different from SaaS review platforms or UGC tools?

SaaS platforms like Yotpo, WiserReview, Stamped, etc., charge $110 to $5,000 per year.

UGCify is a self-hosted WooCommerce plugin. You can use it for free for basic UGC reviews, or go for it’s LTD to get more layouts, social review import, rewards system, and influencer portal.

6. Can I moderate submissions before they go live?

Absolutely. Every submission goes through your moderation dashboard first. Nothing appears on your store until you approve it.

7. What do you mean by “Shoppable” UGC Galleries?

It means, when people view photo and video reviews, they will get the option to add the product to the cart right then an there, i.e., they can shop while watching reviews.

Plus, you can even tag products on any image for people to hover and add to cart. (This is Pro feature.)

Is my customer data safe?

All content is stored on your own WordPress hosting. Nothing is sent to external servers. You have full control and ownership.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Customer photos and videos remain in your WordPress media library. Your data is never held hostage.

Privacy Policy

If you explicitly opt in to usage tracking, we collect specific telemetry data via PostHog to improve plugin performance and troubleshoot issues.

What Data is Collected?

No data is collected by default. If you provide consent, the following information is gathered:
* System Environment: WordPress version, PHP version, and active theme/plugin names.
* Plugin Details: UGCify version and non-sensitive configuration settings.
* Usage Patterns: Feature usage and in-plugin page views.
* Contact Info: Site administrator email address.

External services

This plugin connects to the following external services. No data is sent to any of these services unless you explicitly use the corresponding feature.

Meta / Instagram Graph API

Used by the Instagram integration feature to authenticate your Instagram Business account via OAuth and to fetch public posts matching your configured hashtags.

  • What is sent: During OAuth, your browser is redirected to Meta’s login page. After authorisation, the plugin exchanges an authorisation code for an access token using your site’s server. Hashtag search requests include your access token and the hashtag text.
  • When it is sent: Only when an admin connects an Instagram account or when the scheduled hashtag sync runs (requires the integration to be enabled and configured).
  • Service provider: Meta Platforms, Inc.
  • Terms of service: https://developers.facebook.com/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

YouTube oEmbed API

Used to fetch metadata (title, thumbnail) for YouTube video URLs that are imported as video reviews.

  • What is sent: The YouTube video URL.
  • When it is sent: Only when an admin imports a YouTube video review.
  • Service provider: Google LLC
  • Terms of service: https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/api-services-tos
  • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
